title: Level 1 (Beginner) - B-27
notes:
West leads the ♠Q against 7NT. South has more than enough tricks for his grand slam. The problem is one of communication between the two hands. The club suit is blocked and West's spade lead has taken out dummy's only side entry.

South can unblock his winners by discarding his ♣A on dummy's second spade winner. South can now cash the ♣K, ♣Q, and ♣J discarding South's 3 small diamonds. The rest of South's hand is high.
